title: Amazon adds warning labels to NYC shipments over proposed act
excerpt: Amazon is placing warning labels on packages in New York City regarding a proposed Delivery Protection Act.
body_html:
Amazon is currently using shipping labels on packages to contest the New York City Council and the Delivery Protection Act.

The newly applied labels state that the legislation could potentially increase the cost of Amazon orders by up to $5.

The Delivery Protection Act under consideration would effectively prohibit certain third-party arrangements that Amazon currently utilizes.
